name: JavaScript: JSE-40-01 Certified Entry-Level JavaScript Programmer (JS Institute)
material_vintage: OpenEDG JS Institute JSE-40-01 exam syllabus (status ACTIVE), fetched live on 2026-09-26 from jsinstitute.org/jse-exam-syllabus and itemised in full. Exam format: 30 items; pass = cumulative 70%; block weights 8/20/18/21/21/12%. The JS Institute publishes no past papers, so every practice and test item is original, written to the published objectives. Exam-dump sites were not used. Every code-output answer key was generated by running the code in Node.js 22; browser-only features (alert, confirm, prompt, the DOM) are taught with examples to try in a browser console and tested by multiple-select items instead.
level_source: standalone: a vendor certification with no RQF/FHEQ level
